story.title: The Little Bear Who Kept Trying

scenes.title: A Little Start
scenes.body: A little bear wanted to climb to the top of Sunflower Hill. The hill was steep and slippery. He took a deep breath and started to climb.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: A Slippery Slide
scenes.body: The little bear slipped and tumbled down onto soft moss. He felt like giving up. But he wiggled his paws and stood back up.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: A Friendly Cheer
scenes.body: A little sparrow chirped, “You can do it!” The bear tried a new path. He stepped carefully around the big rocks.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: Almost There
scenes.body: The bear’s legs felt tired, but he kept going. He thought of the golden sunrise waiting for him. One more step, then another.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about perseverance.

scenes.title: A Bright Finish
scenes.body: At last the little bear reached the top. The sun peeked over the hills and painted the sky pink and gold. He smiled and said, “I did it because I kept trying!” Then he sat down to watch the beautiful morning.
scenes.altText: Scene 5 of a story about perseverance.
